local g = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Util");
local L = g and(g:FindFirstChild("GetWaterHeightAtLocation"));
if not L then
return nil;
end;
local g, e = pcall(require, L);
if not g or type(e) ~= "function" then
return nil;
end;
CB_WATER_WALK.waterHeightModule = e;
end;
local g, L = pcall(CB_WATER_WALK.waterHeightModule, Q);
if not g then
return nil;
end;
return tonumber(L);
end;
function CB_WATER_WALK.getTerrainWaterHeight(Q, g)
local L = RaycastParams.new();
L.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;
local e = {Q};
if CB_WATER_WALK.pad then
table.insert(e, CB_WATER_WALK.pad);
end;
L.FilterDescendantsInstances = e;
L.IgnoreWater = false;
Q = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(g.X, g.Y + 24, g.Z), Vector3.new(0, - 72, 0), L);
if Q and Q.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
return Q.Position.Y;
end;
return nil;
end;
function CB_WATER_WALK.resolveWaterHeight(Q, g)
local L = CB_WATER_WALK.getWaterHeight(g) or(CB_WATER_WALK.getTerrainWaterHeight(Q, g));
if L then
CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterY = L;
CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterPosition = g;
CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterSeenAt = os.clock();
return L;
end;
L = CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterPosition;
Q = L and(Vector2.new(g.X, g.Z) - Vector2.new(L.X, L.Z)).Magnitude or 1 / 0;
if CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterY and Q <= 64 and os.clock() - (CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterSeenAt or 0) <= 2.5 then
return CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterY;
end;
return nil;
end;
function CB_WATER_WALK.hasLandAtSurface(Q, g, L)
local e = RaycastParams.new();
e.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;
local y = {Q};
if CB_WATER_WALK.pad then
table.insert(y, CB_WATER_WALK.pad);
end;
local Q, p = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies");
if Q then
table.insert(y, Q);
end;
if p then
table.insert(y, p);
end;
e.FilterDescendantsInstances = y;
e.IgnoreWater = true;
y = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(g.X, L + 10, g.Z), Vector3.new(0, - 30, 0), e);
return y ~= nil and y.Position.Y >= L - 1;
end;
function CB_WATER_WALK.hidePad()
CB_WATER_WALK.active = false;
if CB_WATER_WALK.pad then
CB_WATER_WALK.pad.CanCollide = false;
end;
end;
function CB_WATER_WALK.ensurePad()
local Q = CB_WATER_WALK.pad;
if Q and Q.Parent then
return Q;
end;
Q = Instance.new("Part");
Q.Name = "CB_WaterWalkPad";
Q.Anchored = true;
Q.CanCollide = false;
Q.CanTouch = false;
Q.CanQuery = false;
Q.CastShadow = false;
Q.Transparency = 1;
Q.Size = Vector3.new(40, 1, 40);
Q.Parent = workspace;
CB_WATER_WALK.pad = Q;
return Q;
end;
function CB_WATER_WALK.update()
if game.PlaceId ~= CB_WATER_WALK.SEA_ONE_PLACE_ID or not d[9].WalkOnWater then
CB_WATER_WALK.hidePad();
return;
end;
if not CB_EXPERIENCE.Allows("movement.glitches") then
CB_WATER_WALK.hidePad();
return;
end;
local Q = i.Character;
local g, L = Q and(Q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")), Q and(Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"));
if not g or not L or L.Health <= 0 then
CB_WATER_WALK.hidePad();
return;
end;
local e = CB_WATER_WALK.resolveWaterHeight(Q, g.Position);
local y = e and(CB_WATER_WALK.active and e - 18 or e - 8) or nil;
if not e or y > g.Position.Y or g.Position.Y > e + 14 or(CB_WATER_WALK.hasLandAtSurface(Q, g.Position, e)) then
CB_WATER_WALK.hidePad();
return;
end;
y, Q = CB_WATER_WALK.active, CB_WATER_WALK.ensurePad();
Q.CFrame = CFrame.new(g.Position.X, e - Q.Size.Y * 0.5, g.Position.Z);
Q.CanCollide = true;
CB_WATER_WALK.active = true;
local Q, p = e + L.HipHeight + g.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.15, g.AssemblyLinearVelocity;
if not y and g.Position.Y < e + 2 or y and g.Position.Y < Q - 0.85 and(p.Y < - 1 or g.Position.Y < e + 1.5) then
g.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(p.X, math.max(p.Y, 0), p.Z);
g.CFrame = CFrame.new(g.Position.X, Q, g.Position.Z) * (g.CFrame - g.Position);
end;
end;
function CB_WATER_WALK.clear(Q)
CB_WATER_WALK.hidePad();
if CB_WATER_WALK.pad then
pcall(function()
CB_WATER_WALK.pad:Destroy();
end);
CB_WATER_WALK.pad = nil;
end;
if Q and CB_WATER_WALK.character and CB_WATER_WALK.character.Parent then
pcall(function()
if CB_WATER_WALK.originalAttributeWasNil then
CB_WATER_WALK.character:SetAttribute("WaterWalking", nil);
else
CB_WATER_WALK.character:SetAttribute("WaterWalking", CB_WATER_WALK.originalAttribute);
end;
end);
end;
CB_WATER_WALK.character = nil;
CB_WATER_WALK.originalAttribute = nil;
CB_WATER_WALK.originalAttributeWasNil = false;
CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterY = nil;
CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterPosition = nil;
CB_WATER_WALK.lastWaterSeenAt = 0;
end;
function _G.__CokeboysWaterWalkCleanup()
if CB_WATER_WALK and CB_WATER_WALK.clear then
CB_WATER_WALK.clear(true);
end;
end;

function CB_LAVA_WALK.captureAttribute(Q, g)
local L = Q:GetAttribute(g);
if L == nil then
return CB_LAVA_WALK.attributeNil;
end;
return L;
end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.restoreTouchProtection()
if CB_LAVA_WALK.touchCharacterConnection then
pcall(function()
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchCharacterConnection:Disconnect();
end);
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchCharacterConnection = nil;
end;
for Q, g in pairs(CB_LAVA_WALK.touchConnections) do
if g then
pcall(function()
g:Disconnect();
end);
end;
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchConnections[Q] = nil;
end;
for Q, g in pairs(CB_LAVA_WALK.touchOriginal) do
if Q and Q.Parent then
pcall(function()
Q.CanTouch = g;
end);
end;
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchOriginal[Q] = nil;
end;
local Q, g = CB_LAVA_WALK.touchCharacter, CB_LAVA_WALK.attributeOriginal;
if Q and g then
for L, e in pairs(g) do
pcall(function()
if e == CB_LAVA_WALK.attributeNil then
Q:SetAttribute(L, nil);
else
Q:SetAttribute(L, e);
end;
end);
end;
end;
CB_LAVA_WALK.attributeOriginal = nil;
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchCharacter = nil;
end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.bindTouchProtection(Q)
if not d[9].WalkOnLava or not Q then
return;
end;
if CB_LAVA_WALK.touchCharacter ~= Q then
CB_LAVA_WALK.restoreTouchProtection();
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchCharacter = Q;
CB_LAVA_WALK.attributeOriginal = {LavaWalking = CB_LAVA_WALK.captureAttribute(Q, "LavaWalking"), LavaImmune = CB_LAVA_WALK.captureAttribute(Q, "LavaImmune"),
MagmaWalking = CB_LAVA_WALK.captureAttribute(Q, "MagmaWalking")};
end;
end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.isLavaPart(Q)
if not Q or not Q:IsA("BasePart") then
return false;
end;
if Q.Name == "CB_LavaWalkPlate" then
return false;
end;
if Q.Name == "CB_LavaFloatPad" then
return false;
end;
if string.lower(Q:GetFullName()):find("icelavaterrain", 1, true) then
return false;
end;
local g, L = string.lower(Q.Name or ""), Q.Parent and(string.lower(Q.Parent.Name or "")) or "";
return Q.Material == Enum.Material.CrackedLava or g:find("lava", 1, true) ~= nil or g:find("magma", 1, true) ~= nil or L:find("lava", 1, true) ~= nil or L:find("magma", 1, true) ~= nil;
end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.isWalkableLavaSurface(Q)
if not CB_LAVA_WALK.isLavaPart(Q) then
return false;
end;
local g = Q.Size;
if g.Y > 8 or g.X < 18 or g.Z < 18 then
return false;
end;
if string.lower(Q:GetFullName()):find("lavaparts", 1, true) then
return true;
end;
local g, L = string.lower(Q.Name or ""), Q.Parent and(string.lower(Q.Parent.Name or "")) or "";
if g:find("lava", 1, true) or(g:find("magma", 1, true)) then
return true;
end;
if L:find("lava", 1, true) then
return true;
end;
return Q.Material == Enum.Material.CrackedLava;
end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.protectLavaTouch(Q)
if not d[9].WalkOnLava or not CB_LAVA_WALK.isLavaPart(Q) then
return false;
end;
if not Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter") then
return false;
end;
if CB_LAVA_WALK.touchOriginal[Q] == nil then
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchOriginal[Q] = Q.CanTouch;
CB_LAVA_WALK.touchConnections[Q] = Q:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanTouch"):Connect(function()
if d[9].WalkOnLava and Q.Parent and Q.CanTouch then
Q.CanTouch = false;
end;
end);
end;
Q.CanTouch = false;
return true;
end;

end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.scanLavaParts()
local Q = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace;
CB_LAVA_WALK.lavaParts = {};
CB_LAVA_WALK.walkableParts = {};
for g, g in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants()) do
if CB_LAVA_WALK.isLavaPart(g) then
table.insert(CB_LAVA_WALK.lavaParts, g);
CB_LAVA_WALK.protectLavaTouch(g);
if CB_LAVA_WALK.isWalkableLavaSurface(g) then
table.insert(CB_LAVA_WALK.walkableParts, g);
end;
end;
end;
CB_LAVA_WALK.scanned = true;
CB_LAVA_WALK.lastRefresh = tick();
end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.refresh()
if not CB_EXPERIENCE.Allows("movement.glitches") then
if CB_LAVA_WALK.wasActive then
CB_LAVA_WALK.clear();
end;
return false, "experience-blocked";
end;
if not d[9].WalkOnLava then
if CB_LAVA_WALK.wasActive then
CB_LAVA_WALK.wasActive = false;
CB_LAVA_WALK.clear();
end;
return;
end;
CB_LAVA_WALK.wasActive = true;
CB_LAVA_WALK.bindTouchProtection(i.Character);
if CB_LAVA_WALK.scanned and tick() - (CB_LAVA_WALK.lastRefresh or 0) < 30 then
return;
end;
CB_LAVA_WALK.scanLavaParts();
for Q, g in pairs(CB_LAVA_WALK.plates) do
if not Q or not Q.Parent or not d[9].WalkOnLava then
CB_LAVA_WALK.plates[Q] = nil;
if g then
pcall(function()
g:Destroy();
end);
end;
end;
end;
end;
function CB_LAVA_WALK.findSurfaceY(Q)
local g, L;
for e, y in ipairs(CB_LAVA_WALK.walkableParts or {}) do
if y and y.Parent then
e = y.Size * 0.5;
local p, D = math.max(math.abs(Q.X - y.Position.X) - e.X, 0), math.max(math.abs(Q.Z - y.Position.Z) - e.Z, 0);
local j, s = (p * p + D * D) ^ 0.5, y.Position.Y + e.Y;
if j <= 8 and s > - 100 and s < Q.Y + 25 and(not g or j < g) then
g, L = j, s;
end;
end;
end;
return L;
end;

local y = Q.pendingEdge;
if not y then
return false;
end;
e = e or(Q.now());
if e > y.at + Q.correlationWindow then
if Q.pendingEdge == y then
Q.pendingEdge = nil;
end;
return false;
end;
if not Q.valid(y.character, y.stunObject, y.generation) or y.token ~= Q.edgeToken or(tonumber(y.stunObject.Value) or 0) <= 0 then
if Q.pendingEdge == y then
Q.pendingEdge = nil;
end;
return false;
end;
local p, D, D, D = Q.hostileEvidenceFor(y.at, e);
if not p then
return false;
end;
Q.openLease(y, e, D);
return true;
end;
Q.moverCandidate = function(e, y, p, D, j, s)
if type(e) ~= "table" or e.Character ~= y or type(e.ID) ~= "number" or type(e.Parent) ~= "table" or e.Parent.Parent ~= p or e.Removing or e.Enabled ~= true or type(e.Destroy) ~= "function" then
return false;
end;
y, p = tonumber(e.StartTime), tonumber(e.Duration);
if not y or not p or p <= 0 or p == 1 / 0 then
return false;
end;
e = j - y;
return e >= 0 and e < p and D >= s and D - s <= Q.moverWindow and math.abs(D - e - s) <= Q.moverWindow;
end;
Q.cancelDamageMovers = function()
local e, y = Q.character, Q.root;
if Q.disposed or not Q.enabled() or not Q.bodyMover or e ~= i.Character or not e or not y or y.Parent ~= e then
return;
end;
local p = Q.attributeTimes.Character;
local D, j, s = math.max(p.LastDamageTick or - 1 / 0, p.LastDamageTakenAt or - 1 / 0), Q.now(), tick();
if j - D > Q.moverWindow then
return;
end;
local rg, Xg = pcall(Q.bodyMover.GetActive, Q.bodyMover, e);
if not rg or type(Xg) ~= "table" then
return;
end;
p, rg = {}, {"BodyVelocity", "BodyPosition", "BodyGyro"};
for Vg, Vg in ipairs(rg) do
for Ng, Qg in pairs(Xg[Vg] or {}) do
Ng = type(Qg) == "table" and Qg.value;
if Q.moverCandidate(Ng, e, y, j, s, D) then
p[#p + 1] = Ng;
end;
end;
end;
rg = false;
for Xg, Xg in ipairs(p) do
rg = if Q.moverCandidate(Xg, e, y, j, s, D) then
if pcall(function()
Xg:Destroy();
end) then
true
else
rg
else
rg;
end;
D = Q.stunObject;
if rg and D and(Q.valid(e, D, Q.generation)) and(tonumber(D.Value) or 0) > 0 then
Q.openLease({at = j, value = D.Value, character = e, stunObject = D, generation = Q.generation}, j, {"DamageCorrelatedMover"});
end;
end;

Q.onStunChanged = function(e, y)

Q.lastStunValue = p;

Q.invalidateSuppression();
return;

Q.suppress(y, "STUN_REASSERTION_SUPPRESSED", p);
return;
end;
if s and(j > s.expiresAt or j > s.hardCapAt) then
Q.endLease(s, "expired");
end;
if p <= 0 and Q.pendingEdge and Q.pendingEdge.stunObject == y then
Q.pendingEdge = nil;
end;
if D <= 0 and p > 0 then
Q.edgeToken = Q.edgeToken + 1;
local D = {token = Q.edgeToken, generation = Q.generation, character = e, stunObject = y, value = p,
at = j};

Q.verifyEdge(D);

end;

C7.parseFruitCooldown = function(arg)
if type(arg) == "table" then
local cooldown = arg.Cooldown;
if type(cooldown) == "table" then
if cooldown.RequirementMet == true then
return 0;
end;
local num = tonumber(cooldown.TimeEnds);
if num then
return math.max(0, num - DateTime.now().UnixTimestamp);
end;
num = C7.parseFruitCooldown(cooldown.ErrorMessage);
if num then
return num;
end;
end;
cooldown = tonumber(arg.TimeEnds);
if cooldown then
return math.max(0, cooldown - DateTime.now().UnixTimestamp);
end;
return C7.parseFruitCooldown(arg.ErrorMessage);
end;
if type(arg) == "number" then
return math.max(0, arg);
end;
if type(arg) ~= "string" then
return nil;
end;
local v7 = string.lower(arg);
local match, M7 = v7:match("(%d+)%s*:%s*(%d+)%s*to%s*hours?");
if match then
return tonumber(match) * 3600 + tonumber(M7) * 60, true;
end;
match, M7, arg = v7:match("(%d+)%s*:%s*(%d+)%s*:%s*(%d+)");
if match then
return tonumber(match) * 3600 + tonumber(M7) * 60 + tonumber(arg);
end;
M7, arg = v7:match("(%d+)%s*:%s*(%d+)");
if M7 then
return tonumber(M7) * 60 + tonumber(arg);
end;
local n6, flag2, M7, O7, F7 = 0, false, v7:match("(%d+)%s*h") or(v7:match("(%d+)%s*hour")), v7:match("(%d+)%s*m") or(v7:match("(%d+)%s*minute")), v7:match("(%d+)%s*s") or(v7:match("(%d+)%s*second"));
if M7 then
flag2, n6 = true, n6 + tonumber(M7) * 3600;
end;
if O7 then
flag2, n6 = true, n6 + tonumber(O7) * 60;
end;
if F7 then
flag2, n6 = true, n6 + tonumber(F7);
end;
if flag2 then
return n6;
end;
n6 = tonumber(v7:match("^%s*(%-?[%d%.]+)%s*$"));
return n6 and(math.max(0, n6)) or nil;
end;

r.cleanLoadoutName = function(V, w)
V = tostring(V or "");
if w == "Fruit" then
local w = 1;
while true do
local L = V:find("-", w, true);
if not L then
break;
end;
local Vg, Wg = V:sub(1, L - 1), V:sub(L + 1);
if Vg ~= "" and Vg == Wg then
V = Vg;
break;
end;
w = L + 1;
end;
end;
return V ~= "" and V or "None";
end;
r.toolCategory = function(V)
if not V or not V:IsA("Tool") then
return nil;
end;
local w, L = tostring(V:GetAttribute("WeaponType") or ""):lower(), tostring(V.ToolTip or ""):lower();
if w == "melee" or L == "melee" then
return "Melee";
end;
if w == "demon fruit" or L == "blox fruit" or L == "fruit" then
return "Fruit";
end;
if w == "sword" or L == "sword" then
return "Sword";
end;
if w == "gun" or L == "gun" or(V:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunctionShoot")) then
return "Gun";
end;
return nil;
end;
r.readLoadout = function(V)
local w, L, Vg = {Melee = "Unknown", Fruit = "Unknown", Sword = "Unknown", Gun = "Unknown"}, {}, {};
local function Wg(cg)
if not cg then
return;
end;
for W7, E7 in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do
W7 = r.toolCategory(E7);
if W7 and not Vg[W7] then
Vg[W7] = true;
w[W7] = r.cleanLoadoutName(E7.Name, W7);
L[W7] = r.readToolIcon(E7);
end;
end;
end;
Wg(V.Character);
Wg(V:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"));
if not Vg.Fruit then
Wg = V:FindFirstChild("Data") or(V:FindFirstChild("PlayerData"));
local V = Wg and(Wg:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit") or(Wg:FindFirstChild("Fruit")));
if V and(V:IsA("ValueBase")) then
w.Fruit = r.cleanLoadoutName(V.Value, "Fruit");
end;
end;
return w, L;
end;
r.readToolIcon = function(V)

end;
w = nil;

local Wg = L and Vg and Vg.Icon;

{image = Wg.Image, color = Wg.ImageColor3 or(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), offset = Wg.ImageRectOffset or Vector2.zero,
size = Wg.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero}
else
w;
end;
if not w then
local L = tostring(V:GetAttribute("OriginalImage") or V.TextureId or "");
w = if L ~= "" then
{image = L, color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), offset = V:GetAttribute("ImageRectOffset") or Vector2.zero,
size = V:GetAttribute("ImageRectSize") or Vector2.zero}
else
w;
end;
r.iconCache[V] = w or false;
return w;
end;

r.refreshRoster = function()
if not r.grid.Parent then
return;
end;
r.rosterDirty = false;
local V, w = {}, {};
for L, L in ipairs(h:GetPlayers()) do
if L ~= i then
V[#V + 1] = L;
w[L] = true;
end;
end;
table.sort(V, function(L, Vg)
return string.lower(L.DisplayName or L.Name) < string.lower(Vg.DisplayName or Vg.Name);
end);
for L in pairs(r.cards) do
if not w[L] then
r.removePlayerCard(L);
end;
end;
for L, Vg in ipairs(V) do
w = r.cards[Vg] or(r.createPlayerCard(Vg));
w.frame.LayoutOrder = L;

end;
r.applyFilter();

end;

function CB_FAST_MODE.process(V, w, m)
if not V then
return true;
end;
local T = (os.clock());
for a, a in ipairs(V:GetDescendants()) do
if m ~= CB_FAST_MODE.generation or not CB_FAST_MODE.requested then
return false;
end;
if a:IsA("BasePart") then
if w[a] == nil then
w[a] = a.Material;
end;
a.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;
elseif a:IsA("Texture") and not a:GetAttribute("Offset") then
a:Destroy();
end;
if os.clock() - T > 0.008333333333333333 then
task.wait();
T = (os.clock());
end;
end;
return true;
end;
function CB_FAST_MODE.apply(V)
V = V == true;
CB_FAST_MODE.requested = V;
CB_FAST_MODE.generation += 1;
local w = CB_FAST_MODE.generation;
task.spawn(function()
local m, T = pcall(function()
local a = require(G:WaitForChild("Global"));
if V then
if a.FastMode then
CB_FAST_MODE.setNativeUI(true);
return;
end;
if a.reducing then
for Z = 1, 40, 1 do
if w ~= CB_FAST_MODE.generation or a.FastMode or not a.reducing then
break;
end;
task.wait(0.1);
end;
if w ~= CB_FAST_MODE.generation then
return;
end;
if a.FastMode then
CB_FAST_MODE.setNativeUI(true);
return;
end;
end;
a.reducing = true;
a.FastMode = true;
a.FastModeCache = {};
local Z = a.FastModeCache;
if not CB_FAST_MODE.process(workspace:FindFirstChild("Map"), Z, w) then
return;
end;
if not CB_FAST_MODE.process(G:FindFirstChild("Unloaded"), Z, w) then
return;
end;
if w ~= CB_FAST_MODE.generation then
return;
end;
Z = i:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts");
Z = Z and(Z:FindFirstChild("OptimizerClientActor"));
if Z and Z.SendMessage then
Z:SendMessage("Optimize", true);
end;
CB_FAST_MODE.setNativeUI(true);
else
a.FastMode = false;
a.reducing = false;
local Z = a.FastModeCache;
a.FastModeCache = nil;
if type(Z) == "table" then
local a = (os.clock());
for L, Vg in pairs(Z) do
if w ~= CB_FAST_MODE.generation then
return;
end;
if L and L.Parent then
L.Material = Vg;
end;
if os.clock() - a > 0.008333333333333333 then
task.wait();
a = (os.clock());
end;
end;
end;
Z = i:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts");
Z = Z and(Z:FindFirstChild("OptimizerClientActor"));

(function()
local r, w, m, T = {busy = false, generation = 0, attemptToken = 0, attempt = 0, maxAttempts = 5,

browserState = nil, detectedRegion = nil, historyRegionChecked = false, regionProbeBusy = false, regionProbeToken = 0,
nextRegionProbe = 0, historyFile = "CokeboysServerHopHistory_v1.json", historyTTL = 2700};
local function a(Z)
return tostring(Z or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "";
end;
local function Z(L)
L = tonumber(L) or 0;

function CB_SESSION_INFO.formatDuration(r)
r = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(r) or 0));
local w, T, Z, L = math.floor(r / 86400), math.floor(r % 86400 / 3600), math.floor(r % 3600 / 60), r % 60;
if w > 0 then
return string.format("%dd %02dh %02dm %02ds", w, T, Z, L);
end;
if T > 0 then
return string.format("%dh %02dm %02ds", T, Z, L);
end;
return string.format("%dm %02ds", Z, L);
end;

function CB_SESSION_INFO.resolveServerStartedAt()
local r, w = CB_SESSION_INFO.serverNow(), getgenv().__CokeboysServerClock;
if type(w) == "table" and w.jobId == game.JobId and type(w.startedAt) == "number" and w.startedAt <= r + 5 and r - w.startedAt < 2678400 then
return w.startedAt;
end;
if CB_SESSION_INFO.serverScanReady ~= true then
return nil;
end;
if type(CB_SESSION_INFO.lastServerScan) == "number" and time() - CB_SESSION_INFO.lastServerScan < 10 then
return nil;
end;
CB_SESSION_INFO.lastServerScan = time();
if type(getgc) ~= "function" then
return nil;
end;
local T, Z = pcall(getgc, true);
if not T or type(Z) ~= "table" then
T, Z = pcall(getgc);
end;
if not T or type(Z) ~= "table" then
return nil;
end;
T = {};
for L, Xg in ipairs(Z) do
if type(Xg) == "table" then
local Vg, dg, Qg = pcall(function()
return rawget(Xg, "TimeIn") or(rawget(Xg, "timeIn")), rawget(Xg, "Group") or(rawget(Xg, "group"));
end);
if Vg and type(dg) == "number" and(Qg == "Island" or Qg == "Sea") and dg > 1500000000 and dg <= r + 5 and r - dg < 2678400 then
L = math.floor(dg + 0.5);
T[L] = (T[L] or 0) + 1;
end;
end;
end;
w, Z = 0;
for r, L in pairs(T) do
if L > w or L == w and(not Z or r > Z) then
w, Z = L, r;
end;
end;
if Z and w >= 2 then
getgenv().__CokeboysServerClock = {jobId = game.JobId, startedAt = Z};
return Z;
end;
return nil;
end;
function CB_SESSION_INFO.rgb(r)
return string.format("rgb(%d,%d,%d)", math.floor(r.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(r.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(r.B * 255 + 0.5));
end;
function CB_SESSION_INFO.formatBounty(r)
r = math.max(0, tonumber(r) or 0);
if r >= 1000000000 then
return string.format("%.2fB", r / 1000000000);
elseif r >= 1000000 then
return string.format("%.2fM", r / 1000000);
elseif r >= 1000 then
return string.format("%.2fK", r / 1000);
end;
return tostring(math.floor(r));
end;
